'''Locational Enforcement''' was a branch of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. They were tasked with the physical security of the Authority's facilities, such as [[Farm/Legends|farms]] and [[Factory/Legends|factories]]. The importance of the facility determined the number of personnel and equipment assigned to the location. Mechanically maintained [[waste converter]]s might rate only a single officer, while power stations required a staff of hundreds. Locational Enforcement operatives worked as undercover investigators and forensics specialists; they assisted [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] in their investigations.<ref name="HSCS" />

The organization of Locational Enforcement directly mirrored the structure of [[Territory Administration]]. Each [[Territory]] had an [[OverPrecinct]] assigned to it to handle duty assignments and personnel. [[Region]]s were served by a [[Precinct]], [[Zone]]s had a [[Sub-Precinct]], and [[Market (Corporate Sector Authority)|Markets]] included a [[Station]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
